message.content: {"action":"decrease_precision","reason":"Current best numerical point is coef_frac=15 with rne (SQNR ~85.1 dB). Decreasing precision to coef_frac=14 previously gave SQNR ~78.7 dB while reducing area (~4% direct, ~0.4% symmetric), and there are 3 legal unvisited neighbors, offering a balanced trade-off between numerical quality and mapped area. Increasing precision is unavailable, and switching architecture/rounding has already been explored without further area gains at the same precision."}
